g.text: Explicit messages resolve competing offers to an idle worker.

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #526474

g.text: Schematic of the implemented neighbor-push protocol, not a timed trace. Donors reserve queued IDs before

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #526474

g.text: offering; the receiver accepts one offer and rejects a competing offer. Accepted inputs travel over a

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #526474

g.text: peer edge; identified results return directly to the master. No hub-assisted hint policy is implemented
